summary: Turkcell Iletisim Hizmetleri A.S. filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer equivalent of a US Form 8-K) disclosing a September 24, 2026 board resolution authorizing its wholly-owned subsidiary Turkcell Finansman A.S. to issue up to TRY 6 billion of management agreement-based lease certificates (sukuk) in the domestic Turkish market, in one or more tranches, with maturities up to 12 months, via private placement and/or sales to institutional investors, without a public offering. The issuance is subject to Capital Markets Board approval. This is an ordinary financing arrangement, not a special situation; no acquisition, divestiture, tender, or change of control is involved. Watch for CMB approval and tranche pricing.
